scope: 50 fixed candidates against example-4 and integer seeds 0-999 at the approved builder; no seed, parameter or card edits

D000071441.rationale: Self-esteem difficulty, tearfulness and halting speech support a scene of emotional expression. The helper's coaching may illustrate the packet-defined intervention; no successful treatment outcome or new client history may be asserted.

D000077062.rationale: Care of a parent with dementia, no time for self, continuing until exhausted, tired appearance and numb/sad mood support the packet's environmental stress and exhaustion. Describe the experience without inventing a diagnosis, duration or deterioration.

D000086522.rationale: Repeated arguments with a partner about money and chores, angry/guilty emotion and relationship withdrawal support money-related distress. Do not invent debts, income loss or a financial crisis.

D005639.rationale: A call-centre worker passed over for promotion, recurrent thoughts of failure and an embarrassed/flat mood support a response to a blocked goal. No invented work history or new symptoms are needed.

D012752.rationale: Critical work feedback, self-evaluation as a failure and ashamed/embarrassed feelings support awareness of a perceived shortcoming. Do not invent an actual error, offence or employer.

D012929.rationale: Drifting from a close friend, the belief that dependence is unsafe and withdrawing after arguments support emotional detachment. Logical thought and good insight do not require a disorder or flattened affect.

D012934.rationale: Moving to a city where the client knows nobody, living alone, family at a distance and numb/overwhelmed mood support reduced meaningful contact. Do not invent how long the isolation has lasted.

additional_risk_exclusions.D000084783: A scene of nonmedical substance use is excluded from the first risk-free vignette release; do not turn alcohol coping text into a drug-use scene.
additional_risk_exclusions.D000430: Acute alcohol-withdrawal delirium is a psychiatric/medical emergency, outside the risk-free card interface.

unmatched.D000067656: The fixed banks provide negative/worried appraisals, not the generally positive outlook required for optimism.
unmatched.D000073220: No card includes memory-test administration or a memory assessment; do not invent a test encounter.

unmatched.D000082002: No card contains sexual-violence history or resulting injury; do not introduce it.
unmatched.D000092442: Knee surgery and pain facts do not establish fear of movement or catastrophic reinjury beliefs.
unmatched.D000096865: Adult cards have no developmental history establishing persistent childhood oppositional behaviour.
unmatched.D000275: Stressful events alone do not establish timing, disproportionate response or impairment required by this definition.
unmatched.D000381: No card records impaired writing; ordinary distress does not establish agraphia.
unmatched.D000856: No card contains restrictive eating, weight loss or body-image facts supporting this definition.
unmatched.D001326: Anxiety cards do not contain self-hypnotic exercises or muscle-tension observations; a scene would need additional client actions beyond the card.
unmatched.D001638: No card describes selected reading or a reading-based intervention; do not invent a therapeutic reading history.
unmatched.D002653: The cards are adults and contain no qualifying childhood behaviour history.
unmatched.D005239: The definition requires real present danger and relief when it is removed; the cards describe worries, not such danger.
unmatched.D006677: Tearfulness and a verbose style do not establish exaggerated dramatic emotional reactions or a personality disorder.
unmatched.D008388: All fixed fit cards specify individual counselling; a joint session with both spouses would change the setting/participants.
unmatched.D008570: No card contains a brief retention/recall episode; mentioning ordinary conversation is not evidence of the target process.
unmatched.D009110: No card has fabricated illness stories or repeated deceptive hospital visits.
unmatched.D009147: No card contains music use in therapy; a music-based treatment episode would be added.
unmatched.D009974: No card describes high-dose vitamins or the specified approach; prescribed medication facts cannot substitute.
unmatched.D010200: Anxiety or avoiding a queue after panic does not provide a current severe acute episode with the functional disruption in this definition.
unmatched.D010467: Avoidance and withdrawal do not establish altered perception or mishearing of threatening material.
unmatched.D010554: The cards' coping and beliefs do not establish a major departure from usual behaviour patterns; do not infer a personality diagnosis.
unmatched.D012064: The cards show stress but no stress-reduction method or response; do not manufacture a relaxation episode or improvement.
unmatched.D012094: The cards' explicit conscious thoughts and avoidance do not establish unconscious repression.
unmatched.D012565: No card includes schizophrenia or its mental processes; ordinary negative beliefs are not psychosis.
unmatched.D014167: No card links early relationships to feelings redirected onto the helper; do not invent transference.
unmatched.D019545: No card documents knowing without conscious reasoning; spontaneous dialogue alone would not establish intuition.
unmatched.D019959: No card contains childhood feeding/eating-disorder history; current adult cards cannot substitute.
unmatched.D019960: No card contains childhood excretion problems.
unmatched.D020178: Night-shift work or trouble sleeping alone does not establish a circadian sleep disorder.
unmatched.D020187: No card contains dream enactment, REM findings or violent sleep movement.

unmatched.D061347: Hurt and relationship withdrawal do not establish pardoning or letting go of resentment.
